verdict.rationale: A business and home phone service with an app and online dashboard could plausibly publish an API spec, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no API documentation, and probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt file is a prose product summary, not a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
